scripts.tts:generate: sh -c 'VOICE=public/audio/voice-clone.wav; if [ -f "$VOICE" ]; then pocket-tts generate --text "Hello world this is a demo" --voice "$VOICE" --output-path public/audio/speech.wav; else pocket-tts generate --text "Hello world this is a demo" --output-path public/audio/speech.wav; fi'
scripts.align:gentle: curl -s -F "audio=@public/audio/speech.wav" -F "transcript=Hello world this is a demo" "http://localhost:8765/transcriptions?async=false" > public/alignment/output.json
